name: Zenith Invisibreak
name_jp: 究極インビジブレイク
effects: Seven single attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Wind/Poison, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Thief (I)]

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Wind/Poison, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Thief (I)]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Thief (I)
description.text: Increases [Wind/Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Thief (I) after using a Thief ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Invisibreak+
description.text: Six single attacks (? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Thief (I)
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Thief 1], [Thief Instant Cast 1] and [Thief +30% Boost 1] to the user/party if there are 0-3/4+ Thief members

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
